When Eligible Charges multiplied by the Facility specific CCR ("Claim Cost") for an AHCCCS APR DRG exceed the inpatient Cost Outlier Threshold, which is the sum of the facility specific AHCCCS APR DRG base rate plus the AHCCCS Fixed Loss Amount ("Outlier Threshold") as defined by AHCCCS at the date of discharge, Facility will receive the contract rate as described in Section 2.2 plus the Inpatient Outlier. The Inpatient Outlier is calculated by multiplying the Marginal Cost Percentage as determined and defined by AHCCCS, by the difference of the Claim Cost and the Outlier Threshold, as defined by AHCCCS. That product is multiplied by the AHCCCS Transition Multiplier, as determined by AHCCCS and the Covered Day Adjustment Factor, as applicable. The final product is multiplied by the AHCCCS APR DRG negotiated percentage as indicated in Table 1.

If the Claim Cost exceeds the Outlier Threshold, then the claim qualifies for a DRG outlier add-on payment. The Outlier Threshold is calculated as: Outlier Threshold = Unadjusted DRG Base Payment + Fixed Loss Amount. The Fixed Loss Amount is $5,000 for Critical Access Hospitals (CAH) and $65,000 for all other providers. For claims that qualify, the Unadjusted DRG Outlier Add-on Payment will be calculated as: Unadjusted DRG Outlier Add-on Payment = [Claim Cost – Outlier Threshold] * DRG Marginal Cost Percentage. The DRG Marginal Cost Percentage is 90% for burn DRGs and 80% for all other DRGs. Additionally, qualifying administrative days are paid at per diems when billed separately from acute services.
